C0764.title: Vice President and Team Lead of Tianmou Digital Entertainment Leaked Game Source Code to Distributors
C0764.summary: Zhang A, then Vice President of Tianmou Digital Entertainment, and Zhang B, a game team lead, leaked the server and client source code for the game 'Three Kingdoms Enhanced Edition'.
